# Set-ZbxAction

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an action.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxAction [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixAction>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-EventSource <ZabbixEventSource>] [-Status <ZabbixActionStatus>] [-EscalationPeriod <string>] [-PauseSymptoms <bool>] [-PauseSuppressed <bool>] [-Filter <ZabbixActionFilterRequest>] [-Operation <ZabbixActionOperationRequest[]>] [-RecoveryOperation <ZabbixActionRecoveryOperationRequest[]>] [-UpdateOperation <ZabbixActionUpdateOperationRequest[]>] [-NotifyIfCanceled <bool>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An action reacts to events: when its conditions match a trigger, discovery, autoregistration, internal or service event, it sends messages, runs scripts or changes hosts. The Set-ZbxAction cmdlet changes the actions given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with action.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every action the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed actions back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Disable an action

```powershell
Set-ZbxAction -InputObject 'Notify on disaster' -Status Disabled -PassThru | Select-Object Name, Status
```

-InputObject takes the action's name, id or object; only the parameters given are sent (action.update). With -PassThru the changed action is read back and written to the pipeline; without it nothing is.

### Example 2: Enable every action a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on*' | Set-ZbxAction -Status Enabled -PassThru | Select-Object Name, Status
```

Get-ZbxAction writes action objects; Set-ZbxAction binds each one and updates them in one batched call.

### Example 3: Replace the filter

```powershell
$conditions = @(
    New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType TriggerSeverity -Operator MoreEqual -Value 4
    New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType HostGroup -Operator Equal -Value (Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Web servers').GroupId
)
Set-ZbxAction -InputObject 'Notify on disaster' -Filter @{ evaltype = 'And'; conditions = $conditions }
(Get-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on disaster' -SelectFilter).Filter.conditions | Format-Table conditiontype, operator, value
```

-Filter replaces the whole filter: here the action is narrowed to severity High or above on 'Web servers' hosts.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixAction>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -EscalationPeriod (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixEventSource`: Bound to -EventSource (ByPropertyName). The event source values: EVENT_SOURCE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixActionStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The action status values: ACTION_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `bool`: Bound to -PauseSymptoms (ByPropertyName), -PauseSuppressed (ByPropertyName), -NotifyIfCanceled (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixActionFilterRequest`: Bound to -Filter (ByPropertyName). filter of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -Operation (ByPropertyName). operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionRecoveryOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -RecoveryOperation (ByPropertyName). recovery_operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionUpdateOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -UpdateOperation (ByPropertyName). update_operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixAction`: Action class.
